Introduction:
Welcome to the project page for the reconstruction of Westmount Road (Northfield Drive to Benjamin Road). The City intends to reconstruct this road to replace the aged sewers and road structure with a new urban cross-section (i.e. sidewalk, curbs and asphalt). This will also include widening the sidewalk on the east side and a new multi use pathway (MUP) on the west side.
This page will be used for updates and information regarding the project work. Typically, major notices and updates will be posted here in addition to hard copy notices delivered to residents/owners. Minor updates may be posted on Engage Waterloo only. Subscribe to follow this project and provide your email address to receive updates as they become available.
